description: Synonym and uncertain remedy-name groups for review. NOT applied to the book files yet. 'suggested_target_name' is the name to use if the group is approved (Boericke-MM name, updated where web research showed a different official/standard name). null = do not merge / undecided.

synonym_groups.note: Same plant (black cohosh). HPUS official homeopathic name is 'Cimicifuga racemosa'; 'Actaea racemosa' is the current botanical name. Boericke uses Cimicifuga; Clarke/Kent use Actaea.
Confirmed same remedy. 'Acetanilidum' is the official homeopathic name (HPUS); 'Antifebrinum' is the historical trade name for acetanilide.
Same plant (burdock). Botanical name is 'Arctium lappa'; Boericke's heading 'Lappa arctium' is the traditional homeopathic remedy name.

Web check: 'Asclepias syriaca' is the accepted botanical and HPUS name; 'Asclepias cornuti' is an obsolete synonym. Boericke uses the outdated 'ASCLEPIAS CORNUTI', so applying this group would also rename the Boericke key.
Same plant (yerba santa). 'Eriodictyon californicum' is the accepted botanical name; 'glutinosum' is a synonym.
Confirmed same nosode (rabies). Preferred/official name is 'Lyssinum'; 'Hydrophobinum' is the older synonym and 'Lyssin' the English variant.

'Spigelia anthelmia' is the HPUS official species (Hahnemann's proving). Kent's 'anthelmintica' is an old epithet of the same species. NOTE: Clarke's 'Spigelia Marilandica' is a DIFFERENT species (Carolina/Indian pinkroot) and must stay separate - removed from this group.
Same remedy (musk root). 'Sumbulus moschatus' is the botanical name; 'Sumbul' is the short form.
Same substance (tannic acid). Boericke 'Tannicum acidum'; Clarke 'Tannin'.
Same remedy (couch grass). 'Agropyron repens' is a synonym of 'Triticum repens' (modern botanical name Elymus repens).
Clarke's chapter combines TWO remedies: Chromicum Acidum AND Chromium Oxidatum. Suggested target covers only the chromic-acid part; decide whether to split the Clarke chapter.
Clarke's chapter combines TWO remedies: Rhus radicans AND Rhus toxicodendron. Suggested target covers only the toxicodendron part; decide whether to split the Clarke chapter.

uncertain_groups.note: CONFIRMED DISTINCT (web): Hydrastinum muriaticum (hydrastine muriate) and Hydrastininum muriaticum (hydrastinine muriate) are salts of two different goldenseal alkaloids with different clinical pictures (Clarke). Do NOT merge.
CONFIRMED SAME (web): both are benzene (C6H6). Boericke 'BENZOLUM', Clarke 'Benzinum'. Clarke's Benzinum Nitricum / Benzinum Dinitricum are different substances and stay separate.
CONFIRMED SAME (web): whooping-cough nosode. 'Pertussinum' is the preferred/standard name; 'Coqueluchinum' is Clarke's later synonym (after a trademark dispute over 'Pertussin').
CONFIRMED SAME (web): Kent's 'Manganum' is Manganum aceticum (the Hahnemannian proving). Boericke's full name is 'MANGANUM ACETICUM'.

CONFIRMED DISTINCT (web): Ferrum phosphoricum hydricum is ferrous hydrophosphate (FeHPO4), a separate, rarely used preparation proved by Dr. J. C. Morgan - distinct from Ferrum phosphoricum (ferric phosphate / Schuessler salt #4). Do NOT merge.
